name: PR detail Files changed tab renders the reviewer-ordered Smart Diff
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab (Smart order is the default) and confirm the reviewer-ordered grouping renders: the Core logic section leads with src/middleware/ratelimit.ts, and the Boilerplate section carries pnpm-lock.yaml. Deterministic seeded data (no model call) — the classifier is pure, so the grouping appears the instant the PR is imported. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md; depends on the 9-file seed).

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
steps.label: open the PR row
navigate to the PR detail route
switch to the Files changed tab
diff tab is active in the URL
the Smart Diff core group header renders
the core file leads the core group
the lockfile is grouped under boilerplate
